title: alpha.task/4
description: Task content object. Schedule lives on alpha.moment/1; optional deadline_at on the task. Links zero or more Projects via project_ids. Optional mail_thread_id links a mail thread 1:1.

project_id.description: Deprecated singular from alpha.task/1 — clients should prefer project_ids

status.description: recurring legacy → planned; schedule via moments with recurrence

deadline_at.description: Optional due date; calendar bars come from moments, not this field

due_at.description: Legacy alias for deadline_at (alpha.task/2); normalize to deadline_at on write

depends_on.description: Other task ids this task depends on

mail_thread_id.description: JMAP / feed mail thread id when this task was promoted from mail (1:1)
